categories.name: build
categories.rationale: The change adds a compile-time configuration flag to a depends package. From a build system perspective, it does not affect build reproducibility, platform support, or CI reliability, merely updating an upstream package build flag to support wallet requirements.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Changes SQLite wallet database options in src/wallet/sqlite.cpp, removes WalletDatabase::Rewrite, and adds functional tests in test/functional/wallet_encryption.py.
categories.rationale: Enabling secure_delete resolves a security defect where passphrase changes and record deletions leave plaintext key material or previous master keys in unallocated database pages. As noted in the description, 'changing the passphrase can leave the original encryption key record in free pages', undermining encryption guarantees.
